recommendation:
Channel calendar recommendation for a February 10 launch:
- Pre-launch (7–10 days out): Use social to tease the overview asset and drive awareness; publish a web landing page or homepage feature preview that introduces the overview and sets expectations.
- Launch day (February 10): Send the email announcing the launch and linking to both the overview and demo; update the web channel with the full launch content; post social announcements with concise messaging and links.
- Post-launch (1–2 days after): Share a demo-focused follow-up on social, repurpose key points from the overview in web follow-up content, and send a short email reminder or recap highlighting the demo for users who missed the first message.
- Ongoing: Keep web as the central source of truth, use email for high-intent updates and recap, and use social for repeated reach and engagement.
This calendar fits a general audience by keeping messages clear, staggered, and easy to digest across email, web, and social.
